featured_reviews.review_text:
A fantastic and interactive Bollywood experience!

What a great experience! This tour is an absolute must if you're looking for an incredibly fun and interactive outing.

We started our day by dressing up in various iconic Bollywood outfits. We took pictures in these, which were then edited so professionally that it felt like we were in a real movie! After that, we hit the studio to sing our hearts out to famous Bollywood songs. As a great finale to this part, we even got to dance along with real Bollywood dancers.

Next, we were given a fascinating tour through the different studios. It was incredibly fun and special to get a peek at an active film set! After that, we were guided through the other studios and received engaging explanations about the whole process. This really brought the magic of filmmaking to life for us.

Finally, I want to give a huge compliment to the staff: everyone was incredibly friendly, enthusiastic, and helpful. They truly made this experience complete!

It is not a bad visit in itself, but it may create expectations that are not fully aligned with reality. In my view, it is not truly a Bollywood experience in the way it is advertised.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Film Studios: The Heart of Cinematic Magic

Film studios are the creative powerhouses that bring stories to life, turning scripts into immersive visual experiences. These spaces are more than just physical locations—they are hubs of imagination, where directors, actors, and technicians collaborate to craft films that captivate audiences worldwide. From grand soundstages to cutting-edge post-production facilities, film studios play a vital role in shaping the magic of cinema. Whether producing large-scale blockbusters or intimate indie films, these studios provide the foundation for storytelling at its finest, blending artistry with technical brilliance.

Yash Raj Films: A Legacy of Excellence in Indian Cinema

Yash Raj Films (YRF) stands as a pillar of Indian cinema, synonymous with grandeur, romance, and timeless storytelling. Founded by the visionary Yash Chopra, YRF has redefined Bollywood with its unparalleled craftsmanship, producing films that resonate across generations. From heartwarming love stories to gripping thrillers, the studio has consistently set new benchmarks in filmmaking. Beyond its artistic brilliance, YRF has also built an empire with its state-of-the-art studios, fostering talent and innovation. With its keen eye for storytelling and commitment to excellence, Yash Raj Films continues to shape the future of Indian cinema, leaving an indelible mark on audiences worldwide.

featured_reviews.name: Mesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
HIGHLIGHT - If you have been to Hyderabad's version, you will likely find this visit a complete letdown.

My recent visit to Mumbai Film City was far from what I had hoped. To start, the nearest metro station is Aarey, it is about 4 km away. From there, take an auto (no more than ₹150) straight to the official ticket counter. Be cautious, several individuals may try to sell you tickets along the way at inflated prices. Avoid them, as they are scammers.

After a long wait, we were taken inside the premises by an AC bus. Unfortunately, the experience was underwhelming from the beginning. Compared to Hyderabad's Film City, this one feels small, restricted, and poorly organized. Most of what you see are large tin sheets covering the sets, there is no access to the actual sets themselves. It felt like being shown billboards of what you could see, but never actually do.

The tour ends at Bollywood Park, which hosts a few staged performances. This was the only mildly enjoyable part. The on site restaurant is strictly vegetarian, which may not appeal to everyone, and the food was overpriced for its quality.

Overall, Mumbai Film City lacks substance, feels commercialized, and fails to deliver the behind the scenes magic one would expect. If you have been to Hyderabad's version, you will likely find this visit a complete letdown.

Manikarnika Films, founded and owned by Kangana Ranaut, stands as a reflection of her fearless spirit, creative independence, and dedication to Indian storytelling. Established with the aim of producing original, content-driven cinema, the production house symbolizes empowerment—both in the kind of stories it tells and in the way it operates. Kangana launched the banner after the success of Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi, with a vision to create films that celebrate India’s cultural roots, strength, and individuality.

The production house’s debut project, Manikarnika, set a high standard for historical epics in Bollywood. Despite production challenges and creative differences, Kangana’s leadership as both director and producer ensured the film’s completion with grand visual quality, emotional depth, and patriotic fervor. The attention to historical authenticity in sets, costumes, and performances reflected Manikarnika Films’ commitment to excellence.

Beyond grandeur, the company’s philosophy emphasizes meaningful cinema over commercial compromise. Kangana has repeatedly voiced her intent to nurture new talent—writers, directors, and technicians—through her banner, encouraging fresh voices in Indian cinema. Her later projects under Manikarnika Films, such as Tiku Weds Sheru, further showcase her willingness to experiment with genres while maintaining artistic integrity.

In essence, Manikarnika Films is not just a production house—it’s a statement of creative freedom, self-reliance, and national pride. Under Kangana Ranaut’s leadership, it continues to embody her belief that cinema should inspire, challenge, and celebrate the power of individuality in the Indian film industry.

featured_reviews.review_text: Movement Hub a place I called home way before this space was in existence. The Hub is actually not just a physical space but a space to explore, to move and find yourself. Kunal the Director of the Movement Hub is a person who makes you feel welcome and at home whoever you might be and whatever stage you are at with your dancing. This new space we have been given to call our home is just as magical as the idea behind the Hub. It’s a space which you won’t find anywhere in Mumbai with sprung flooring, a warmup area and a cute office for the team and their guests. The studio about 1000 sq feet is a nice quiet space for people to move comfortably in. The unique fact is the wall with the beautiful mural is not straight but curved, it flows just like we do when we move. The changing room and bathroom super clean and spotless which is quite a nice thing to see in a community space in Mumbai. All the other facilities, Pooja, Shahan, Pranit and Dipen are so amazing dancers and movers as well and learnt a lot from them as well as Kunal over the last few years in the Hub. Like it says “ home is where the heat is and the heart is where the Hub is” I would definitely recommend this place to everyone who wants to just move and enjoy

If you are someone who loves to DANCE, wants to EXPLORE dance styles, find your niche, and GROW as a dancer then this is guaranteed to be the best place for you. I’ve been dancing in classes and workshops across different countries, and I can assure you that The Movement Hub is one of the best places for a dancer to thrive. For those who are new to dance: The studio provides classes across various dance styles and music genres. You can take the single class workshops and have a super fun experience whenever you wish! If you want to keep learning, you will definitely improve in leaps and bounds by joining their month long workshops.
For those who have been dancing for a while: The choreographers here have a very well rounded approach to dance, helping you understand the nuances of movement. They teach you not only the vocabulary of dance within their specific styles, but also help you train the physical and mental aspects of it, ultimately helping you GROW as a dancer. After training here, I definitely saw a huge improvement in my quality of movement and performance.
Lastly, the space and the community are extremely welcoming. There is no pressure to excel, but the desire for it will come from you naturally when you immerse yourself in such a loving and encouraging environment.
Thankful that Mumbai’s dance scene has a place like this now.
